meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先宣告“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,然后扮演一个 5 人对抗团队的协调者,让五个角色互相攻击彼此的计划,只保留经得住批评的要点,最后交给“ulw-plan”规划器生成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”、“hpp”、“adversarial plan”等触发词,或要求进行需要最高严谨度、暴露薄弱假设、盲点与过度设计的规划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这个功能。
say.note: Claude 会宣告模式开启并启动对抗评审。

say.text: 请用 hpp 对这个方案做对抗性评审。
say.note: 五个成员会互相攻击,只留经得起批评的部分。

say.text: 用 hostile planning 制定实施计划。
say.note: 最终交给 ulw-plan 规划器形式化。

howto.what_en: On load, Claude says "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", leads a 5-member adversarial team that attacks each other's plans, keeps only surviving insights, then passes them to the ulw-plan planner.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "hyperplan", "hpp", "adversarial plan", etc., or when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.
